text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Looking great.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(With this, the path has opened wide. The 
path to the Classic races——)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey really is the real deal! We 
can expect great things in the Classic 
races too...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, that went way beyond my 
expectations... Unlike Stay Gold, could 
she be an early bloomer?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—Then, shall we proceed as planned along 
the Classic Triple Crown route?"

Having returned to the waiting room, Dream 
Journey matter-of-factly confirmed our 
future strategy.

Because everything seemed so completely 
normal—

"...Today, in a GⅠ race packed with 
top-tier talent, Dream Journey achieved a 
brilliant result that paves the way to the 
Classic Triple Crown."

The crowd surely harbored high 
expectations. Even so, the girl in 
question... seemed completely indifferent.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――I'm truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume... I am truly honored to 
have run in a GⅠ today and achieved 
results. However—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you could call it my nature. I am 
rather inept at expressing feelings of 
emotion... It is certainly not that I am 
unhappy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...If I have made you uncomfortable, 
Trainer, I am truly sorry.
choice_data_list: No, I'm not uncomfortable at all...!

text_block_list.text:
True, everyone has their own measure for 
expressing emotion. Joy takes a different 
shape for each person.

Wanting Dream Journey to be happier... 
perhaps that's just my own ego speaking.
choice_data_list: I'm the one who should be apologizing...
I'm the one who should be sorry...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...... The 『Asahi Hai FS』 is, even among 
the numerous GⅠ races, a personally 
important one for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
One of the reasons for that... is the 
presence of an Umamusume named Grass 
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume who ran alongside Sis 
on many occasions—one of the "Storms" who 
etched incredible records into history—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She has won today's Asahi Hai FS in the 
past, and went on to enjoy a long, 
successful career all the way through the 
Senior division.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
For me, who seeks to embark on a long 
journey just like "Big Sis"... this holds 
immense significance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore, being able to deliver results 
today makes me truly happy.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And the fact that you guided me to this 
stage... is just the same.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Please, smile. A sad face doesn't suit 
you.

"...Having it explained helped me 
understand completely. The meaning behind 
today's result for her."

As her Trainer, right now I should respect 
Dream Journey's way of doing things, trust 
in her, and celebrate with all my heart.
choice_data_list:
I'm so happy I get to aim for the Classic 
Triple Crown with you!

I'm truly happy to be able to aim for the 
Classic Triple Crown with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, me too.

...Next year will begin with the Satsuki 
Sho. The Satsuki Sho that Stay Gold 
couldn't run in.

"I'm sure she can achieve even greater 
success in the Classic division than Stay 
Gold did."

And that... should lead directly to the 
end of the journey she seeks...!
choice_data_list: (Time to refocus and get fired up...!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho, huh...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Of the Classic Triple Crown races, the 
only one Ane-go ever challenged was the 
Kikuka Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(I never got the chance to run in the 
'Satsuki Sho' or the 'Japanese Derby'.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(...It's undeniably right before my eyes. 
The path that Big Sis was never able to 
walk—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fuhaha...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so happy.

Under a cloudless night sky where stars 
faintly twinkled, there was a traveler who 
eagerly awaited a storm.

"Whether that rare prayer will bear fruit 
shall be proven when May arrives. So 
whispered the night wind—"
